title: Loomground observation (patch projection)
description: The externally visible result of projecting a policy graph (specification, Conformance). Matches a conformance vector's expected.json. Canonical form: nodes, cords, and reservations are always present (reservations is [] when empty); redress appears only when at least one redress declaration exists; prohibitions and obligations are not projected (additionalProperties: false). See specification, Conformance.

grade.description: granted autonomy grade on an actor; membership is checked against the active ladder at apply

grade_required.description: required autonomy grade threshold on a source gate; membership is checked against the active ladder at apply

on_behalf_of.description: the actor's delegator (an actor or a human) — one link of the principal chain, projected on the delegate's node

party.description: the party currently responsible, projected as a node attribute on an actor or gate; for a partyless delegate, the party resolved along the principal chain

duration.description: temporal window on a reserved action (present only when declared)

on_elapse.description: resolution when the duration elapses; halt = deny (safe default), proceed = fail-open

redress.description: Canonical projection: each redress materializes `overturn` (false when absent) and `within` (null when absent), unlike the patch surface where both are optional.
